overall: The AG found the Northfield Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to summarize the answers given in its February 18 hearing minutes, ordering revised minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the February 18 planning board minutes lacked an adequate summary of discussions, including answers given at three solar array public hearings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to include a sufficient summary of the discussions that took place for each public hearing during the February 18 meeting.

remedy: Revise the February 18 meeting minutes and certify to the Attorney General's office within sixty (60) days of the date of the letter that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to revise those meeting minutes and to certify to this office within sixty (60) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
